title: Zions Bank Celebrates Grand Opening of Herriman Branch
summary: Zions Bank Celebrates Grand Opening of Herriman Branch
body_markdown:
HERRIMAN, Utah; June 12, 2025 — Zions Bank’s branch staff joined with executives and members of the community to celebrate the grand opening of its Herriman branch, located at 5048 W. Herriman Boulevard.


Herriman City Mayor Lorin Palmer, city staff, and representatives from the South Valley Chamber of Commerce and Mountain West Chamber of Commerce joined Zions Bank president and CEO Paul Burdiss and other bank executives and staff for the ribbon cutting.


Strewn with bills totaling $2,500, the red ribbon was cut and funds were donated to Herriman’s Compassion Community Center, a food pantry that supports 180 families weekly.


Speaking at the event, Palmer said Zions Bank had demonstrated commitment to the community even before it broke ground on the facility.


“Whether it’s supporting local events, investing in community programs, or helping residents and small businesses with their financial goals, Zions Bank has demonstrated a clear commitment to Herriman and the people who call it home,” he said.


Prominently positioned on the corner of 12600 South and Herriman Main Street, the new branch features two lobby teller windows, two drive-up lanes, a night depository, and a drive-up ATM with check-scanning deposit capabilities.


Designed by Prescott Muir Architects and built by Layton ICS, the 3,750-square-foot building boasts a brick and limestone masonry exterior with prominent windows allowing for ample daylight and expansive views in the two-story lobby and customer service area. The building includes a meeting room equipped with virtual conferencing capabilities available for community use.


The Herriman branch opened for business on May 19 and is managed by Jonathan Lewis, who brings 12 years of financial services experience to the position.


“It’s been fantastic to receive a warm welcome from the Herriman Community,” Lewis said. “We look forward to deepening these relationships, which are really at the heart of what we do.”


The Herriman branch is open Monday through Thursday from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., and on Friday from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.


**About Zions Bank**


Zions Bank is Utah’s oldest financial institution and is the only local bank with a statewide distribution of branches operating 93 full-service branches. Zions Bank also operates 26 branches in Idaho and Wyoming. In addition to offering a wide range of traditional banking services, Zions Bank is also a leader in small business lending. Founded in 1873, Zions Bank has been serving the communities of Utah for more than 150 years. Additional information is available at www.zionsbank.com.
